summary: Standard filter bar for product filtering and sorting with dynamic quick filters.
features: Dynamic quick filters with data source selection
Active filters display with mobile visibility toggle
Customizable button variants for filter actions
shortDescription: The Filter Bar section provides essential product filtering and sorting functionality for category and search result pages. It can display dynamic quick filters populated from the data source for one-click filtering by popular attributes. The sticky option keeps the bar visible during scrolling for easy access. Active filters show currently applied selections with optional mobile visibility control. All action buttons (open filter sheet, sort, reset, quick filters) support customizable variants to match the site design.
